rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a royal princess, and it is also used in titles such as “pop princess.”

example.english: That princess is coming to Hong Kong today.
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 gung1 zyu2 gam1 jat6 lei4 hoeng1 gong2

rows.note: Use this for the wife or consort of a prince, as in “Princess of Monaco.”

example.english: The princess attended the banquet with the prince yesterday.
example.traditional: 噚日王妃同王子一齊出席晚宴。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 wong4 fei1 tung4 wong4 zi2 jat1 cai4 ceot1 zik6 maan5 jin3

rows.note: Use this for a pampered or self-important young woman, rather than for a literal royal princess.

example.english: This princess won't even carry her own coffee cup.
example.traditional: 呢位大小姐連自己杯咖啡都唔肯拎。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 daai6 siu2 ze2 lin4 zi6 gei2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dou1 m4 hang2 ling1

rows.note: Use this affectionately for a young girl, especially when speaking warmly to or about her.

example.english: My little princess is going to school for the first time today, and she's so happy!
example.traditional: 我個小公主今日第一次返學，好開心呀！
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 siu2 gung1 zyu2 gam1 jat6 dai6 jat1 ci3 faan1 hok6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3
